title: LT Verdict source-request.v4
description: Backend additionally checks margin_ms and max_idle_gap_ms divisible by step_ms only for fixed; auto allows nonmultiples. max_idle_gap_ms must be at least step_ms. The declared step of an explicit window must divide the window exactly. 1..100000 cells at the declared step is checked only for fixed. Backend also checks end > start, at most 128 UTF-8 bytes and no ISO control characters per profile identifier, and request file at most 16 KiB. Identifiers are sorted during parsing; the document may list them unsorted. An auto window is derived at acquisition time from the run-period.v1 artifact recognized from the same load bytes; the derivation is refused with AUTO_WINDOW_UNAVAILABLE, AUTO_WINDOW_MULTI_TEST_SUSPECTED or AUTO_WINDOW_SPAN_UNSUPPORTED before any external request, and a refusal requires an explicit window. max_idle_gap_ms is intentionally unbounded above: a large declared tolerance weakens the multi-test refusal, and the declared value is published in provenance.

max_idle_gap_ms.description: max_idle_gap_ms must be at least step_ms and a whole number of seconds.
